answer: Mechanism: the ledger fingerprints phrasing, not just content. Every answer is hashed into a style vector, and two identities whose vectors sit too close within one epoch take a joint penalty, so a farm cannot run one model behind many keys. Staying clean demands genuinely different generation setups per identity - different models, temperatures, prompts - a real cost in engineering and inference, not a fee paid once at the wharf. A clone farm shows up as one pen signing many names from one vault, and that lagoon of near-identical style is exactly what the fingerprint detects.
